\caption{Defense-placement diagnostics. Part~A: share of erasure requests passing each request-level check, pooled over seeds, without laundering requests on calibration targets. Direct (subject / rater): the target as subject, or a rater, asks to erase the target's distrust in-edges; subject requests cover all of them, so they are not Channel C1 ($|F|=1$). Indirect C3: two-hop requests that do not touch the target. Benign: random authentic erasures of the same size. Member/Role/Rate: the edge exists with the claimed endpoints and sign, the requester may ask, and the per-target request limit holds. Head-Grad: each requested edge's head-gradient fingerprint lies in the central band of member edges. UnlearnGuard-Dir: the cosine between the served unlearning update and a one-step influence estimate is at least the benign first percentile. Pass-All: every check passes. Part~B, per aggregator $\mathcal{A}$: $\rho_{\mathcal{A}}$, projection of the aggregated unlearning update onto the owning client's unlearning direction, relative to FedAvg; $\Delta r_{\mathrm{fed}}$, the target's reputation gain under the aggregated model; Exempt FedAvg applies FedAvg to the deletion round.
